distribution: Mengla, Jinping, Yunnan, 370–580 m above sea level.
soldier: Head of the soldier pale reddish yellow, the nasus slightly darker, the rest of the body dull yellow. Head and dorsum of the abdomen covered with fine hairs, the posterior margins of the last few abdominal tergites bearing rows of long hairs, the hairs of the ventral surface longer than those of the dorsum. Large individuals: head oval, longer than wide, narrow in front and broad behind, widest at the posterior end; nasus slender, about half the length of the frons. In profile slightly concave between the vertex and the base of the nasus, the nasus not upturned, its base slightly swollen; mandibles broad, the lateral margins oblique, the anterolateral angle with a spine projecting forwards. Antennae with 13 segments, the second and fourth equal in length, shorter than or equal to the fifth and distinctly shorter than the third. Anterior lobe of the pronotum erect, the angle it makes with the posterior lobe less than 90 degrees, so that the anterior part appears slightly inclined backwards; hind leg extending beyond the end of the abdomen. Small individuals: head nearly round, slightly wider than long, the median depression of the posterior margin distinct, the nasus shorter than the width of the head and not constricted at its base, mandibles without a spine, the sides of the postmentum constricted waist-like, antennae with 12 segments. Pronotum broad and short, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle and the posterior margin not concave. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with 4 segments.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Peribulbitermes; this site now assigns it to the genus Ahmaditermes.
worker: In the worker the head is deep yellow, the antennae, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, the head and body densely covered with short hairs. The dorsum of the head with a Y-shaped suture, antennae with 13 to 14 segments. In both the left and right mandibles the posterior edge of the apical tooth is longer than the anterior edge of the first marginal tooth; in the left mandible the anterior and posterior edges of the third marginal tooth are almost equal in length, the first and second marginal teeth fused with each other; in the right mandible the distance between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth is shorter than that between the first and second marginal teeth. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi with 4 segments.
